items.title: Shortical's AI-Generated 'Inevitable' Premieres With Approved AI Double From Aki Avni
items.rationale: A fully AI-generated microseries premieres with an actor's consented AI double. It is a concrete release that tests the consent-based likeness model the unions are pushing for.
items.excerpt: Shortical's fully AI-generated microdrama 'Inevitable' premieres with a consented AI double of actor Aki Avni, putting the industry's AI fears center stage.

items.title: Screenburn Group launches AI tool to write full microdrama seasons
items.rationale: A newly launched tool ('The Writers Room') drafts full 80-episode vertical-drama seasons from a writer's concept, which directly changes the writing workflow for microdramas.
items.excerpt: Screenburn's 'The Writers Room' uses generative AI to draft full 80-episode vertical-drama seasons from a writer's concept.

items.title: Chinese actress Zhao Liying's lawsuit spotlights AI misuse as experts urge stronger oversight
items.rationale: A top Chinese star sues short-drama platform Hongguo and its parent Douyin over unauthorized AI face-swaps of her likeness. It is a new legal filing on AI likeness rights in short dramas.
items.excerpt: Zhao Liying has sued the operator of short-drama platform Hongguo and parent Douyin over alleged unauthorized AI face-swap use of her likeness in short dramas.

items.title: Manchester Animation Festival Announces 2026 Winners, New AI Policy
items.rationale: A major UK animation festival introduces a generative-AI policy for submissions. Animators who submit to festivals must now follow these new rules.
items.excerpt: Manchester Animation Festival named its 2026 winners ('In Waves', 'When the Sea Was Calm', 'A Little Death') and introduced a new generative-AI policy governing submissions.

items.title: ByteDance Releases Seedance 2.5 Flash, a Faster Video Model Priced About 34% Below Seedance 2.5
items.rationale: This is a new model release, not a rehash of the 10-29 Seedance 2.5 launch. The Flash variant generates twice as fast at about a third less cost, and its API opens Nov. 15.
items.excerpt: Volcano Engine's Seedance 2.5 Flash generates video twice as fast as Seedance 2.5 at about 0.99 yuan per second at 720p; API access opens Nov. 15.
